svg.title: SNES xG by shot spot
svg.text: 21,752 off the stick, the best of the nine aims
12,349, the best of the nine aims
23,455, the best of the nine aims (the d-pad aims it)
SNES model (tools/xg_snes.py), Shot Accuracy 13; the goalie set and still at his spot for the puck (Weight 48, Agility 8, Speed 8,
aidef 7). Speeds: the recorded games' medians. A deke's shot is a wrist shot, but the deke's swing first moves the goalie: from a set
goalie this map shows the plain wrist shot, the deke's floor. Squares 10 units (3.3 ft); 240 play-outs each.
